name: ap-learners-licence-practice
description: Offline bilingual (Telugu/English) practice app for the Andhra Pradesh Learner's Licence computer test. Unofficial study aid; not affiliated with any government entity.

scripts.typecheck:content: npx --yes -p typescript@5 tsc --noEmit --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --target es2022 --module esnext --skipLibCheck src/content/questions.ts
scripts.test: npm run validate:config && npm run validate:content && npm run test:scripts
